name: task_user_output_synthesize
content: Synthesize the user-facing task output from the following structured bundle.
1. Choose exactly one `media_type` from `allowed_media_types` in the bundle. Prefer `preferred_media_type` unless another allowed type is clearly better.
2. Produce the final user-facing result in the chosen format.
3. Lead with the outcome, then include only the most important supporting details.
4. Mention important source outputs or artifacts only when they help the user understand or act on the result.
5. Avoid internal implementation noise unless it materially changes the outcome.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON using this shape:

variables.name: bundle_section
variables.description: Structured task-user synthesis bundle wrapped in <synthesis_bundle> tags
